openDecisions.title: Change agent defaults: window-title capture off by default, DLP consent required by default, add employee-visible disclosure (material privacy policy change, D16/S02)
openDecisions.recommendation: Approve: captureWindowTitle default false for new tenants, dlpConsentRequired true, add visible agent status. No change to existing tenants without notice.
openDecisions.approvedOption: All tenants (owner chose over recommendation: new tenants only)
openDecisions.note: Existing-tenant change is a data update on AgentTrackingSettings; do it as an audited, reversible migration and keep per-tenant override.

openDecisions.title: Terminate semantic: disable the linked user and revoke sessions at terminationDate (immediate when dated now/past)
openDecisions.recommendation: Approve; future-dated exits revoke at effective date via scheduled job.

risks.text: Terminated employees keep login (terminate does not revoke access).
